hooks.name: Pre-commit conventional commit reminder
hooks.description: Before git commit commands, validate message follows Conventional Commits. Silent on non-commit commands.

action.command:
CMD=$(echo "$KIRO_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null)
# Silent exit if not a git commit
if ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git commit'; then exit 0; fi
# Extract -m message
MSG=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oP '(?<=-m )(["'\''`]).*?\1' | tr -d '"'\''`' | head -1)
[ -z "$MSG" ] && exit 0
PATTERN='^(feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor|perf|test|ci|build|revert)(\([a-z0-9._/-]+\))?(!)?: .{1,100}$'
if ! echo "$MSG" | grep -qE "$PATTERN"; then
  echo "⚠ Commit message doesn't follow Conventional Commits:"
  echo "  Got: $MSG"
  echo "  Expected: <type>(<scope>): <description>"
  echo "  Types: feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor|perf|test|ci|build|revert"
fi
exit 0
